data.name: Rohith
data.gender_notes: Rohith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rohith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohini', meaning red, and 'It', meaning man. This name signifies a person who comes from the red soil, which is a metaphor for the land of India. The name Rohith carries the meaning “Man of the Red Soil” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Rohith usually hope their child will grow to embody man of the red soil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rohith is a name that is deeply connected to the spiritual traditions of India. It is believed to invoke the blessings of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. This name is also associated with the sun, which is a powerful symbol of life, energy, and creativity.
data.etymology: Rohith belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of the Red Soil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohith total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
